title: Business Operations Analyst
locations: Kuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
teaser: Take on the role of Business Operations Analyst, driving cross-functional collaboration to enhance operational effectiveness and alignment. Utilise AI-assisted tools to analyse data, identify trends, and deliver actionable insights. Ideal for candidates with significant business operations experience and strong analytical skills.
description:
Meet the Team

Our team is passionate about partnering with leadership to drive impactful business decisions and fuel profitable growth. We leverage cutting-edge AI tools and data-driven insights to translate strategy into actionable plans that optimize resources and enhance performance across diverse roles and geographies. We thrive on solving complex challenges by identifying risks and opportunities, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and enabling disciplined execution. Join us, and become part of a dynamic, innovative environment where your contributions directly influence business success.

Your Impact

Drive cross-functional collaboration to enhance operational effectiveness and alignment.

Collect, format, and analyze operational data using AI-assisted tools to identify trends and anomalies.

Conduct structured root cause analyses and develop predictive models to enhance forecast accuracy.

Deliver insights and recommendations aligned with KPIs, budgets, and strategic targets to guide operational execution.

Lead the design and adaptation of dashboards and reporting tools to meet evolving business needs.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement scalable, customer-focused solutions.

Drive process improvements and operational efficiency through automation and advanced methodologies.

Build subject matter expertise in Cisco’s architectures and services to inform operational strategy.

Advise leadership on operational risks, opportunities, and strategic initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree plus 5 years of related experience, or equivalent relevant work experience.

Preferred business and financial certifications such as Excel (Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP, Power Query), Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt, Visio, and Lucidchart.

Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively and communicate clearly in cross-functional settings.

Experience applying AI-enabled tools to improve operational planning and decision-making.

Preferred Qualifications

Proven ability to lead operational initiatives leveraging AI and automation.

Experience advising leadership with data-driven insights and strategic recommendations.

Advanced knowledge of process improvement methodologies and operational governance.

Demonstrated growth mindset with a commitment to continuous learning and coaching peers.

Familiarity with predictive analytics, cost-benefit analysis, and enterprise performance dashboards

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
